.PHONY: test test-fast

test-fast:
	python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q

test:
	python -m pytest -q

The Makefile has two test targets:

- **Unit tests only:** `make test-fast`. This runs `python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q`, so it leaves out the Postgres and network integration tests.
- **Everything:** `make test`. This runs `python -m pytest -q`. Start the database first with `docker compose up db`, because the integration tests need it.

Standard pytest options work if you call pytest yourself, for example `python -m pytest tests/some_test.py -k name`.
